adjacency_data = pd.read_csv('chunks_csv/borough_adjacency.csv')

no2_data['Q3_2023_value'].fillna(no2_data['Q3_2023_value'].mean(), inplace=True)

# Exclude boroughs with any remaining missing values
no2_data.dropna(inplace=True)

no2_data['change'] = no2_data['Q3_2023_value'] - no2_data['Q2_2023_value']

    permuted_moran_i.append(morans_i(change_values, neighbors_matrix))
